scope: Pan-HLA Class I and Class II HLA-DR immune complexes were captured in parallel experiments
For all MHC-1 captures the precleared lysate was incubated with the pan HLA-A-, B-, and C- antibody W6/32 coupled to rProtein A Sepharose fast-flow beads.
